Knowhow / Product & design / Onboarding that feels like a conversation
PRODUCT & DESIGN · CASE STUDY

Has anybody already built a conversational-based onboarding experience?

Replacing setup forms with a few friendly questions.

The question

What should a new user tell us — and accomplish — before we ask them to configure anything?

The approach

Ask two or three plain questions, offer choices as tappable cards, and build an editable example from the answers so the first session begins with progress.

The tradeoff

Conversational steps feel slower to power users, so every question needs a skip and sensible defaults behind it.

What to take with you

Track time to a meaningful outcome. A completed tour can look healthy while users still struggle to begin.
